stemMarkdown: 13 workers, each working 12 hours a day, can complete a job in 7 days. How many days will 25 workers, each working 11 hours a day, take to complete the same job? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total work $= 13 \times 7 \times 12$ worker-hours $= 1092$. With 25 workers at 11 hours/day, days needed $= \dfrac{1092}{25\times11} = 3.97$.
